scope: 40 primary CPR S2 runs; all 20 seeds in both regimes; full 760-run raw audit is separate; no simulator imports, execution, RNG, exclusions or execution-tree writes

definitions.fault_exposure: TX start is inside the half-open fault interval and designated DATA/RREP next hop=path[index+1], ACK next hop=path[index]. Lifetime/frame overlap alone is not an exposed edge attempt.
definitions.path_exposure: Physical source initial DATA starts while fault is active and its full carried route includes a faulted undirected edge.
definitions.chains: For exposed-flow subsets, reconstruct decoded forward and ACK reverse hops using flow, marker, full/prefix path, sender/receiver and nondecreasing physical times. Stage association is observed; isolated causal benefit requires frozen ablations.
definitions.subsets: Path-crossing, actual edge-attempt and their union are explicitly labeled descriptions. Every scheduled flow and all 20 seeds remain in the output and primary denominator.
definitions.hash_scope: Completion identity/byte hash and plan/contract checked here; consumed artifact expected hashes recorded from completion, with full byte validation delegated to independent full-raw audit.
definitions.structural_context: The frozen S2 graph/endpoint/hop settings exactly match the already-reviewed pilot/static matrix; no new BFS or simulator run is performed here. Static alternatives are context, not successful RF paths.

limitations: Default and matched CPR are reported independently but are not extra independent seeds; never pool them as n=40.
Passing an exposure gate supports examining the mechanism, not a positive causal benefit or superiority claim.
Source-state refusal and relay-ledger eviction are different populations; zero eviction does not establish peak occupancy below capacity. Exact peak ledger occupancy is not observed.
S1/S3 is a two-point offered-load comparison, not a saturation threshold. Zero or adverse rows remain included.
S2 and its reference component exposure are reviewed separately by the parent; this file does not certify those outcomes or the entire formal batch.

verified_full_raw_summary_cross_check.scope: Read saved verified summaries only; no repeat of complete 760-run raw audit. The initial 39 manifest-count flags were supervisor-checker false positives; use the verified correction chain.

review_script_provenance_note: script_sha256 records the initial S2 extraction script revision. The final script retains that extraction logic and adds the combined report writer; summary_script_sha256 identifies the current full script. --summary-only does not rerun raw extraction.
